title: Tillman's musician cousins and in-laws, Batiste, Casmes, Gaudet
summary: Allen follows up on Bill Russell's earlier interview: Joe Batiste, the Casme brothers and Hunter Allen Gaudet, Tillman's sister's husband; Vernon Gilbert is not kin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
